items.source: This annotation should not be used if the return value of the method provides only additional information. For example, the main purpose of Collection.add(Object) is to modify the collection and the return value is only interesting when adding an element to a set, to see if the set already contained that element before.
items.translation: 如果方法的返回值仅提供额外信息，则不应使用此注解。例如，Collection.add(Object)的主要目的是修改集合，其返回值仅在向集合中添加元素时才有意义，用于查看该集合在添加之前是否已包含该元素。

items.source: Inspired by org.jetbrains.annotations.CheckReturnValue, this variant has been introduced in the org.springframework.lang package to avoid requiring an extra dependency, while still following similar semantics.
items.translation: 受 `org.jetbrains.annotations.CheckReturnValue` 启发，此变体已引入到 `org.springframework.lang` 包中，以避免需要额外的依赖项，同时遵循类似的语义。

items.source: When used on a type, the annotation applies to all constructors and all methods that do not return void.
items.translation: 当用于类型时，该注解适用于所有构造函数以及所有不返回 `void` 的方法。
